title: Mandi prices
subtitle: Daily APMC prices from Agmarknet (data.gov.in), in ₹ per quintal.
attribution: Source: Agmarknet via data.gov.in (GODL-India). Older Pune data: imported from the 2025 prototype's Agmarknet files.

latest.title: Latest prices
latest.staleWarning: Some prices are more than {{days}} days old. Newer data has not been imported yet.
latest.emptyBody: Prices appear here after they are imported from data.gov.in.

forecast.title: Short-term outlook
forecast.stale: Forecast unavailable: data not current. The latest price is from {{date}} ({{days}} days old); we only forecast from data at most 14 days old.
forecast.notEvaluated: Forecast unavailable: this market has not been backtested yet.
forecast.noData: No price data for this market.
forecast.methodEts: Model: exponential smoothing. In the backtest it was {{pct}}% more accurate than repeating the last price.
forecast.methodNaive: Naive forecast (the last price), because no model beat it in the backtest for this market.
forecast.coverage: In the backtest the 80% range contained the real price {{pct}}% of the time ({{n}} forecast dates).
forecast.disclaimer: Prices can move sharply (gluts, export rules, weather). This is a statistical estimate from past prices, not advice on when to sell.

msp.title: Minimum Support Price (MSP)
msp.none: No MSP is announced for {{commodity}}; its price is set by the market.
msp.note: MSP is the price at which government agencies procure fair-average-quality produce. It is not a guaranteed market price.
